'''Hogan Tinmar''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[sergeant]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He worked for [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] early in the [[Clone Wars]], where he often served as her [[speeder]] driver.<ref name="Pursuit" /> Later in the war, he returned to Naboo, to join the security detail of [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee]] that protected her against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]]. <ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Hogan Tinmar was a [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]<ref name="Join the Battle" /> who was 1.83 [[meter]]s, or 6 [[Foot|ft]] tall.<ref name="Join the Battle" /> He had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown skin.<ref name="Pursuit" />

==Skills and abilities==
Tinmar was effective at armed combat, security and [[Pilot|piloting]] [[airspeeder]]s.<ref name="Join the Battle" />
